races.note: Unopposed: this seat was decided without a general-election contest, so it won't be on your ballot.

cands.name: Wallace Aristide
cands.bio: Educator. Assistant principal of Miami Northwestern High School from 2006, principal from 2011. Democratic member of the Florida House for District 107 since November 2024. Unopposed in 2026.
cands.local_ties: Lives in Miami (per Wikipedia). Long career at Miami Northwestern High School.

record.text: Sponsored the 'Teddy Bridgewater Act', which Wikipedia says passed in March 2026; it lets high school football coaches spend on players for items such as meals and rides.
Placed fourth of six candidates (18.4%) in the 2022 Miami-Dade County Commission race.

money_notes.text: In his 2022 county commission race, Wikipedia reports large donations came from a political committee linked to Genting Group, which planned to build Resorts World Miami.

cands.gaps: Committee assignments, 2026 donors and endorsements not found. Wikipedia notes his official page lists birthplace as Nassau, Bahamas while local media reported Haiti (not resolved). Owner-source search NOT run (shared web-search budget exhausted).

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
